context_and_flow.ux_intent: To facilitate user registration or authentication.
ux_patterns: Primary call-to-action is the red 'Create an account' button.
Third-party login buttons follow standardized branding colors (blue for Facebook/Google, white for Apple).
No hero illustrations; iconography is limited to a generic user silhouette icon.
